Tested numbers and commands throughout. Sequel takes it from one voice note to a live call: why long tags make the voice repeat a line, merging segments to stop pitch jumps at seams, restrained breathing with inline v4 tags, a sound-effect box that carries under the voice, measuring talk density, and a self-check listening pipeline.
